experiment_data.hypothesis: Evaluate 8B Cell C episode-level GRPO model (v9d step 10, val_before_train 96.875%) on 134 OOD ALFWorld tasks (valid_unseen). Step 10 is effective final model (reward saturated at step 12, zero gradients). This is the paper's key data point: 8B model OOD generalization under episode-level GRPO. Retry of 8b_v9d_ood_eval with fixed config (ppo_mini_batch_size=4, env_groups=2, n_groups=[2]).

spec.command:
bash -c "cat > /tmp/fix_ood.py <<'PYEOF'
import re
path = '/root/cost-verify-agent-rl/RAGEN/config/_alfworld_8b_v9d_ood_eval.yaml'
text = open(path).read()
text = re.sub(r'ppo_mini_batch_size:\s*\d+', 'ppo_mini_batch_size: 4', text)
text = re.sub(r'env_groups:\s*\d+', 'env_groups: 2', text, count=1)
new = re.sub(r'(n_groups:\s*\[)\d+(\])', lambda m: m.group(1) + '2' + m.group(2), text, count=1)
if new == text:
    new = re.sub(r'(n_groups:[^\n]*\n\s*-\s*)\d+', lambda m: m.group(1) + '2', text, count=1)
text = new
open(path, 'w').write(text)
print('FIXED')
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/fix_ood.py && grep -n -E 'ppo_mini_batch_size|env_groups|group_size|n_groups' /root/cost-verify-agent-rl/RAGEN/config/_alfworld_8b_v9d_ood_eval.yaml && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/cost-verify-agent-rl/RAGEN && export WANDB_PROJECT=cost-verify-agent-rl && python train.py --config-name _alfworld_8b_v9d_ood_eval"
